title: OlinkViz: Visualization Toolkit for Olink Proteomics Data
description: Ready-made, publication-quality visualization functions for Olink NPX proteomics data. Includes volcano plots, heatmaps, PCA and UMAP projections, boxplots, dot plots, correlation matrices, and longitudinal trajectory plots. Bundles 11 curated Olink datasets from published studies and provides an interactive Shiny application.
